The foreground contains the silhouette of a tall, ornate tower with a spire, bare winter trees, and street lamps. The larger airship is distant and detailed, while the smaller one is closer but less distinct.

The very tip of the foreground tower spire appears to dissolve into the sky rather than terminating in a sharp physical point, suggesting minor generation instability at high-frequency edges.
The lower, smaller airship has a slightly ambiguous orientation; its shape is somewhat blobby compared to the rigid geometry of the upper one, possibly indicating a weaker structural definition.
